"""Native-free per-operation capability request/receipt contract (ADR 0008).

This is an opt-in leaf. Legacy requests, operation fingerprints and canonical
model serializers are untouched. Capability names are requirements, not an
advertisement that this add-on implements an arc/result-3 evidence validator.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from . import request_contracts
from .backend_selection import BackendSelection, SelectionError, lexical_path, resolved_path

BASELINE = "mcad.backend-contract/1"
SOLVER_GUARD = "mcad.solver-dof-cycle-guard/1"
SKETCH_ARCS = "mcad.sketch-arcs/1"
SNAPSHOT_SKETCH3 = "mcad.snapshot-sketch3/1"
ASSEMBLY_STEP_EXPORT = "mcad.assembly-step-export/1"
MAX_CONTRACT_BYTES = 4 * 1024
MAX_CONTRACT_NODES = 36
MAX_RECEIPT_BYTES = 64 * 1024
MAX_GUARDED_REQUEST_BYTES = request_contracts.MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES + MAX_CONTRACT_BYTES
MAX_GUARDED_REQUEST_NODES = request_contracts.MAX_REQUEST_NODES + MAX_CONTRACT_NODES
ACTIONS = frozenset(
    {
        "replay",
        "canonical_snapshot",
        "solve_sketch",
        "check_geometry",
        "export_step",
        "export_stl",
        "assembly_replay",
        "assembly_check",
        "assembly_sample",
        "assembly_export_step",
    }
)
_CAPABILITY = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]{0,95}\Z", re.ASCII)
_NONCE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{32}\Z", re.ASCII)
_DIGEST = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z", re.ASCII)
_RECEIPT_FIELDS = {
    "version",
    "request_id",
    "request_fingerprint",
    "required_capabilities",
    "confirmed_capabilities",
    "missing_capabilities",
    "phase",
    "backend",
}
_BACKEND_FIELDS = {
    "core_version",
    "project_root",
    "core_origin",
    "solver_origin",
    "python_executable",
    "python_executable_target",
    "python_prefix",
    "python_base_prefix",
    "python_version",
}


class BackendContractError(ValueError):
    """A bounded contract error; transports add launched-export uncertainty."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, *, code: str = "backend_contract_invalid"):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code


def _require(condition, message, *, code="backend_contract_invalid"):
    if not condition:
        raise BackendContractError(message, code=code)


def _encode(value, *, compact=False):
    options = {"sort_keys": True, "separators": (",", ":")} if compact else {}
    return json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False, ensure_ascii=True, **options).encode("utf-8")


def _snapshot(value, **limits):
    try:
        return request_contracts.snapshot_request(value, **limits)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError, RecursionError) as exc:
        raise BackendContractError(str(exc)) from exc


def _capabilities(value, *, nonempty=False):
    _require(
        type(value) is list
        and (1 if nonempty else 0) <= len(value) <= 32
        and all(type(name) is str and _CAPABILITY.fullmatch(name) for name in value),
        "Capabilities must be bounded exact lowercase names.",
    )
    _require(value == sorted(set(value)), "Capabilities must be sorted and duplicate-free.")
    return value


def _no_nested_contract(operation):
    pending = [operation]
    seen = set()
    while pending:
        item = pending.pop()
        if type(item) not in (dict, list) or id(item) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(id(item))
        if type(item) is dict:
            _require("backend_contract" not in item, "Nested backend contracts are forbidden.")
            pending.extend(item.values())
        else:
            pending.extend(item)


def _schema(record, allowed, label):
    if type(record) is dict and "schema_version" in record:
        value = record["schema_version"]
        _require(type(value) is int and value in allowed, f"Unsupported {label} schema.")
        return value
    return None


def _has_sketch3(document):
    _schema(document, (1, 2), "Part")
    if type(document) is not dict or type(document.get("features")) is not list:
        return False
    found = False
    for feature in document["features"]:
        if type(feature) is dict and type(feature.get("sketch")) is dict:
            found |= _schema(feature["sketch"], (1, 2, 3), "embedded sketch") == 3
    return found


def _minimum(operation):
    _no_nested_contract(operation)
    _require(
        type(operation.get("protocol_version")) is int and operation["protocol_version"] == 1,
        "Guarded requests require exact protocol version 1.",
    )
    action = operation.get("action", "replay")
    _require(type(action) is str and action in ACTIONS, "Unsupported guarded action.")
    if action.startswith("assembly_"):
        _require(operation.get("kind") == "assembly", "Assembly actions require kind=assembly.")
    else:
        _require("kind" not in operation, "Non-assembly actions cannot select assembly routing.")
    sketch3 = _has_sketch3(operation.get("document"))
    assembly = operation.get("assembly")
    if type(assembly) is dict and "assembly_schema_version" in assembly:
        schema = assembly["assembly_schema_version"]
        _require(type(schema) is int and schema == 1, "Unsupported assembly schema.")
    if type(assembly) is dict and type(assembly.get("part_sources")) is list:
        for source in assembly["part_sources"]:
            if type(source) is dict:
                sketch3 |= _has_sketch3(source.get("document"))
    required = {BASELINE}
    if action == "canonical_snapshot":
        _require("result_version" not in operation, "Snapshots have no result-version argument.")
        if sketch3:
            required.add(SNAPSHOT_SKETCH3)
        return sorted(required)
    version = operation.get("result_version")
    _require(
        type(version) is int and version in (2, 3),
        "Guarded operations require explicit typed result 2 or reviewed result 3.",
    )
    _require(not sketch3 or version == 3, "Schema-3 sources require explicit result 3.")
    required.add(SOLVER_GUARD)
    if action == "assembly_export_step":
        required.add(ASSEMBLY_STEP_EXPORT)
    if version == 3:
        required.add(SKETCH_ARCS)
        if action == "solve_sketch":
            required.add("mcad.solve-result/3")
        elif action.startswith("assembly_"):
            required.update(("mcad.part-result/3", "mcad.assembly-result/3"))
        else:
            required.add("mcad.part-result/3")
            if action != "replay":
                required.add("mcad.geometry-result/3")
    return sorted(required)


def minimum_capabilities(operation):
    """Derive policy only after independently bounding the ordinary request O."""
    return _minimum(_snapshot(operation))


def _guarded_snapshot(guarded_request):
    guarded = _snapshot(
        guarded_request,
        max_bytes=MAX_GUARDED_REQUEST_BYTES,
        max_nodes=MAX_GUARDED_REQUEST_NODES,
    )
    _require("backend_contract" in guarded, "A guarded request requires backend_contract.")
    contract = guarded["backend_contract"]
    _require(type(contract) is dict, "backend_contract must be an object.")
    _snapshot(contract, max_bytes=MAX_CONTRACT_BYTES, max_nodes=MAX_CONTRACT_NODES, max_depth=2)
    _require(
        len(_encode({"backend_contract": contract})) <= MAX_CONTRACT_BYTES,
        "Backend contract exceeds its 4 KiB metadata budget.",
    )
    _require(
        set(contract) == {"version", "request_id", "required_capabilities"},
        "Unknown or missing backend contract field.",
    )
    _require(
        type(contract["version"]) is int and contract["version"] == 1,
        "Unsupported backend contract version.",
    )
    _require(
        type(contract["request_id"]) is str and _NONCE.fullmatch(contract["request_id"]),
        "Backend request ID must be 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.",
    )
    required = _capabilities(contract["required_capabilities"], nonempty=True)
    operation = _snapshot(
        {key: value for key, value in guarded.items() if key != "backend_contract"}
    )
    _require(
        set(_minimum(operation)) <= set(required), "Required minimum capabilities are missing."
    )
    return guarded, operation


def validate_request(guarded_request):
    """Validate G and return detached O, stripping only the known top-level field."""
    return _guarded_snapshot(guarded_request)[1]


def compose_request(operation, *, required_capabilities=None):
    """Create a fresh operation nonce without changing O's authored data or types."""
    ordinary = _snapshot(operation)
    minimum = _minimum(ordinary)
    required = minimum if required_capabilities is None else required_capabilities
    guarded = {
        **ordinary,
        "backend_contract": {
            "version": 1,
            "request_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "required_capabilities": required,
        },
    }
    return _guarded_snapshot(guarded)[0]


def request_fingerprint(guarded_request):
    """Hash full G with exact finite compact ASCII JSON, separately from O."""
    guarded, _ = _guarded_snapshot(guarded_request)
    return hashlib.sha256(_encode(guarded, compact=True)).hexdigest()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, init=False)
class PreparedRequest:
    """Immutable bounded wire bytes and exact O/G projections for one operation."""

    payload: bytes
    _operation_payload: bytes
    request_id: str
    fingerprint: str
    action: str

    def guarded_request(self):
        return json.loads(self.payload)

    def operation_request(self):
        return json.loads(self._operation_payload)


def prepare_request(operation, *, required_capabilities=None):
    guarded = compose_request(operation, required_capabilities=required_capabilities)
    return prepare_guarded_request(guarded)


def prepare_guarded_request(guarded_request):
    """Capture an existing G without generating another nonce or changing O."""
    guarded, ordinary = _guarded_snapshot(guarded_request)
    prepared = object.__new__(PreparedRequest)
    for name, value in {
        "payload": _encode(guarded),
        "_operation_payload": _encode(ordinary),
        "request_id": guarded["backend_contract"]["request_id"],
        "fingerprint": hashlib.sha256(_encode(guarded, compact=True)).hexdigest(),
        "action": ordinary.get("action", "replay"),
    }.items():
        object.__setattr__(prepared, name, value)
    return prepared


def response_snapshot(response):
    """Use the existing response tree/node/depth budget before any recursive copy."""
    try:
        return request_contracts.snapshot_request(
            response,
            max_bytes=request_contracts.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES,
            max_nodes=4_000_000,
            max_depth=32,
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError, RecursionError) as exc:
        raise BackendContractError(str(exc), code="backend_response_invalid") from exc


def project_response(response):
    """Remove only receipt metadata; arbitrary extra fields must survive to reject."""
    snapshot = response_snapshot(response)
    return {key: value for key, value in snapshot.items() if key != "backend_receipt"}


def _error(error):
    _require(
        type(error) is dict
        and set(error) == {"code", "message"}
        and type(error["code"]) is str
        and 0 < len(error["code"]) <= 128
        and type(error["message"]) is str
        and 0 < len(error["message"]) <= 100_000,
        "Failure requires bounded exact code/message fields.",
    )


def common_failure(operation, response, *, contract_level=False):
    """Strict failure-only envelope; never operation or publication authority."""
    expected = {"protocol_version", "ok", "result", "error"}
    if not contract_level and operation.get("action", "replay") != "canonical_snapshot":
        expected.add("result_version")
        _require(
            type(response.get("result_version")) is int
            and response["result_version"] == operation["result_version"],
            "Failure result-version stamp differs from request.",
        )
    _require(
        set(response) == expected
        and response.get("ok") is False
        and response.get("result") is None
        and type(response.get("protocol_version")) is int
        and response["protocol_version"] == 1,
        "Invalid common failure-only envelope.",
    )
    _error(response["error"])
    return response


def _absolute_path(value):
    _require(
        type(value) is str
        and 0 < len(value) <= 4096
        and "\0" not in value
        and os.path.isabs(value),
        "Backend paths must be bounded absolute strings.",
    )


def _identity(backend, selection, *, phase, action):
    _require(
        type(backend) is dict and set(backend) == _BACKEND_FIELDS,
        "Unknown or missing backend identity fields.",
    )
    _require(
        type(backend["core_version"]) is str and 0 < len(backend["core_version"]) <= 64,
        "Invalid observed core version.",
    )
    version = backend["python_version"]
    _require(
        type(version) is list
        and len(version) == 3
        and all(type(item) is int and 0 <= item <= 1000 for item in version),
        "Invalid observed Python version.",
    )
    for key in _BACKEND_FIELDS - {"core_version", "python_version", "solver_origin"}:
        _absolute_path(backend[key])
    solver = backend["solver_origin"]
    if solver is not None:
        _absolute_path(solver)
    if phase == "dispatched":
        _require(
            (solver is None) == (action == "canonical_snapshot"),
            "Dispatched solver origin contradicts the action contract.",
        )
    _require(type(selection) is BackendSelection, "A captured backend selection is required.")
    try:
        core_origin = resolved_path(backend["core_origin"])
        matches = (
            resolved_path(backend["project_root"]) == selection.project_root
            and core_origin == resolved_path(selection.core_origin)
            and lexical_path(backend["python_executable"]) == selection.python_executable
            and resolved_path(backend["python_executable_target"])
            == selection.python_executable_target
        )
        if solver is not None:
            module = Path(resolved_path(solver))
            matches = (
                matches and module.is_relative_to(Path(core_origin)) and module != Path(core_origin)
            )
        _require(
            matches,
            "Observed backend differs from the captured root/interpreter selection.",
            code="backend_identity_mismatch",
        )
    except SelectionError as exc:
        raise BackendContractError(str(exc), code="backend_identity_mismatch") from exc


def validate_receipt(guarded_request, response, selection):
    """Validate full-G correspondence, phase and actual selected backend identity."""
    guarded, operation = _guarded_snapshot(guarded_request)
    bounded = response_snapshot(response)
    if "backend_receipt" not in bounded:
        raise BackendContractError(
            "Selected backend did not provide the required capability receipt.",
            code="backend_contract_unavailable",
        )
    try:
        _require(
            type(bounded.get("protocol_version")) is int
            and bounded["protocol_version"] == 1
            and type(bounded.get("ok")) is bool,
            "Invalid guarded response envelope.",
        )
        receipt = bounded["backend_receipt"]
        _require(
            type(receipt) is dict and set(receipt) == _RECEIPT_FIELDS,
            "Unknown or missing backend receipt fields.",
        )
        _snapshot(
            {"backend_receipt": receipt},
            max_bytes=MAX_RECEIPT_BYTES,
            max_depth=32,
            max_nodes=4_000_000,
        )
        _require(
            type(receipt["version"]) is int and receipt["version"] == 1,
            "Unsupported backend receipt version.",
        )
        contract = guarded["backend_contract"]
        _require(
            type(receipt["request_id"]) is str
            and _NONCE.fullmatch(receipt["request_id"])
            and receipt["request_id"] == contract["request_id"],
            "Receipt belongs to a different operation nonce.",
        )
        _require(
            type(receipt["request_fingerprint"]) is str
            and _DIGEST.fullmatch(receipt["request_fingerprint"])
            and receipt["request_fingerprint"]
            == hashlib.sha256(_encode(guarded, compact=True)).hexdigest(),
            "Receipt belongs to a different complete guarded request.",
        )
        requested = _capabilities(receipt["required_capabilities"], nonempty=True)
        confirmed = _capabilities(receipt["confirmed_capabilities"])
        missing = _capabilities(receipt["missing_capabilities"])
        _require(requested == contract["required_capabilities"], "Receipt requirements changed.")
        phase = receipt["phase"]
        _require(
            type(phase) is str and phase in {"dispatched", "rejected_before_dispatch"},
            "Unknown backend receipt phase.",
        )
        _require(
            not (set(confirmed) & set(missing)) and sorted(confirmed + missing) == requested,
            "Receipt capability partition contradicts the request.",
        )
        if phase == "dispatched":
            _require(
                confirmed == requested and not missing, "Dispatched receipt lacks a requirement."
            )
        else:
            failure = common_failure(operation, project_response(bounded), contract_level=True)
            code = failure["error"]["code"]
            _require(
                code
                in {
                    "backend_capability_missing",
                    "backend_contract_invalid",
                    "backend_identity_mismatch",
                },
                "Unknown pre-dispatch contract failure.",
            )
            _require(
                code != "backend_capability_missing" or bool(missing),
                "Missing-capability rejection has no missing requirements.",
            )
        _identity(
            receipt["backend"], selection, phase=phase, action=operation.get("action", "replay")
        )
        return receipt
    except BackendContractError as exc:
        if exc.code == "backend_identity_mismatch":
            raise
        raise BackendContractError(str(exc), code="backend_response_invalid") from exc
